messages.text: Size PV for my 60-room hotel with 1,200 m2 of roof.

Run run_1M4AK97PCYC175 found 55 feasible designs. The best is 175 kWp of PV with no battery: NPC LKR 124,289,694, LCOE LKR 18.53/kWh, simple payback 4.0 years and a renewable fraction of 48.1%. The grid-only base case has an NPC of LKR 173.0 million. The 2nd design uses 150 kWp.
